/** Production-only widget; checks are performed by the monitor, never the browser. */
import { mountFreshDeploy } from './index.js';
if (import.meta.env.PROD) mountFreshDeploy({
  expectedVersion: import.meta.env.VITE_FD_VERSION,
  manifestUrl: `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}.freshdeploy.json`,
  reportUrl: `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}.freshdeploy-report.json`,
  language: 'en',
  pollIntervalMs: 1000,
  maxReportAgeMs: 60000,
  sseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_FD_SSE_URL || null,
  mode: 'auto',
});
